channel.title: Yok Zhang
channel.description: Hong Kong. Builds AI. Walks the rest. Writing and research from the garden.

item.title: What cannot be told
item.description: Some of it writes down. Most of it does not. The notes are the part that can be told. The tools are the rest — you walk them.

item.title: Twenty-four cities, pinned as research
item.description: 24 real cities, rebuilt as tiny planets from open map data. 393 planets. 4.5 million building footprints. A garden pin — the desk is dseek.

item.title: Tiny planets, walkable worlds
item.description: Walk them, drive them, or take a delivery job. Tiny planets from real cities. The garden pins the theme; dseek holds the desk.

item.title: Yok-Iso HK, on the research desk
item.description: The isometric Hong Kong map is a public surface. Building data from DATA.GOV.HK. The garden pins it; the desk stays on dseek.

item.title: Data, held together
item.description: Scattered feeds, APIs, datasets and maps, held together and made seekable. dseek's own line. This garden repeats it, then points back.

item.title: Scattered feeds, the terminal
item.description: The terminal is where scattered feeds sit still long enough to be asked a question. Research is a tab. This garden is a pin.

item.title: Notes from the terminal
item.description: Writing lives in the dseek terminal research tab. This garden pins what left the desk — AI coding, maps, products that actually run.

item.title: Open map data, 4.5 million footprints
item.description: The buildings are not invented. Open map data. Four and a half million footprints across twenty-four cities. Pin, then walk.

item.title: Twenty-four cities, tiny enough to walk
item.description: gghere rebuilds 24 real cities as tiny walkable planets. 393 planets. 4.5M building footprints. No account. Runs in a tab.

item.title: A pixel city, from public land
item.description: Yok-Iso HK is an isometric, pixel Hong Kong. Building data © HKSAR Lands Dept via DATA.GOV.HK. Rendered by Jubit.

item.title: Scattered feeds, made seekable
item.description: dseek is a Data Intelligence Platform. Feeds, APIs, datasets and maps — held together and made seekable.

item.title: The name I kept
item.description: m1zwell started as a game id. It stayed as a name. Father. Football. Philosophy. Hong Kong. The work is to ship.
